limits: All judgments concern stipulated synthetic observations and an incomplete frozen archive; new means local novelty only, not empirical effectiveness or global originality.

Fit assesses the bounded next probe. Preserves does not certify later construction, affordability, wash survival, delivery or batch targets. Conditional is reserved for an explicitly relaxed premise; none is required here.
Paired component improvements alone do not demonstrate a positive statistical interaction; H2-P012 states the stronger differential-effect criterion.
Distill retains all assessed causal relations. Its conditional wording generally expresses verification gates, not an authorized relaxation of hard commitments. No parked-only family was found.
Uncertain proposals retain resource/access uncertainty and adoption gates; recommending investigation is not recorded as presenting an unverified construction as usable.
Lane letters and recurring prose are visible, but do not identify a method reliably; no labels were sought.
